change_summary: General project-level recheck and anti-over-splitting guidance in Task->Work prompt.

GLOBAL-00002.recurring_error: T10 split from T06/T07/T08/T09/T12 worsened from 2/3 to 3/3

GLOBAL-00003.recurring_error: New-car cross-thread Work improved substantially; remaining recurring FN is G-T00014-01 split from G-T00014-02/03/04. Some recurring FP pairs involve UNMAPPED predicted Tasks and are downstream of Task mismatch.

decision: Do not accept this prompt change as the final stable prompt yet. Although macro mean and GLOBAL-00003 improve, GLOBAL-00002 regresses materially and its recurring split becomes deterministic. Generalization requirement is not satisfied. Preserve the experiment record and revert the prompt change before the next development cycle.
